fields.System.Title: INT-202 — Publish shipment confirmations
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a finance team member, I want the ERP told as soon as goods leave, so that invoices
are raised promptly for exactly what shipped.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a confirmed dispatch, then an event is written to the outbox in the same
  • transaction carrying shipped quantities per line, carrier, and tracking reference.
  • - Given a partial shipment, then the event states which lines and quantities shipped and
  • what remains outstanding.
  • - Given ordering, then a shipment event for an order is never delivered before that
  • order's earlier events.
  • - Given repeated delivery failure, then it dead-letters and alerts.
  • - Given serial-tracked products, then the shipped serials are included.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | platform, outbound |
| Tables | outbox |
| Risks | Lost event means no invoice ([doc 09 §2.4](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)); out-of-order delivery ([doc 08 §10](../../../docs/08-data-sync-and-migrations.md)) |
| Tests | integration · event assertion |
